examples.text: Christina Gutierrez, 34, right, talks with her rescuer, Francisco Martinez, at her in-laws’ home on Jan. 31, 2019. She didn’t know his name when he saved her from two dogs who attacked her as she was walking down a South Side street to work on Jan. 4. She said there were people nearby but no one came to her aid until Martinez, who was driving by on his way to work, stopped his truck to chase off the dogs and cover the badly bleeding woman. He called 911 and stayed with her until EMTs arrived. Doctors said she could have died if Martinez had not intervened. Gutierrez is expected to spend 6 months recovering and will then have to undergo physical therapy.
